One of the most beloved performances at the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre is the "Đánh bắt cá," or Fishing, which has captivated audiences since its inception.

The masterful casting of the bamboo lift net sends white foam splashing across the water, creating a dynamic tableau that captures the essence of rural life. This bustling scene contrasts beautifully against the rippling lake surface, framed by a rustic hanging bamboo screen that adds to the authenticity of the performance.
